purpose_zh: 以一张无文字三联概念图把三处差异化空间原型转译为普通人可读的人尺度体验；图像不生成或升级任何空间、运营、权利或成熟度事实。
purpose_en: Translate three differentiated spatial prototypes into one text-free, human-readable triptych without creating or upgrading any spatial, operational, rights, or maturity fact.

media.generated_with: OpenAI built-in image generation; exact serving snapshot not asserted

cover_media.generated_with: OpenAI built-in image generation; exact serving snapshot not asserted
cover_media.normalization: Centered 16:9 fit from 1672 x 941 to 1600 x 900, RGB conversion, deterministic local overlay, then metadata-free WebP encoding.

deterministic_overlay.type: local raster title and track grammar
required_strings: 验证 VERIFY · 共创 CO-CREATE · 发布 PUBLISH
G0 概念展示 / CONCEPT ONLY
非现场证据 / NOT FIELD EVIDENCE
semantic_line_encoding: continuous solid line labelled 日常路径 / ORDINARY PATH
intermittent dashed line labelled 可选叠层 / OPTIONAL LAYER
branched line with end bar labelled 停止 / 隔离 and STOP / ISOLATE

ordinary.reason_zh: 三幅空间关系可区分，普通无屏路径连续，人尺度清楚，未见否决项。
ordinary.reason_en: The three spatial relationships are distinguishable, ordinary screen-free paths remain continuous, human scale is clear, and no rejection trigger was observed.

cover.reason_zh: 第一版封面因地图图钉与已确认场地读法风险被拒绝，未写入包或清单。
cover.reason_en: The first cover was rejected for map-pin and confirmed-site-reading risk and was not added to the package or manifest.

cover.reason_zh: 修正版无文字底图保留连续日常路径、三处不同人尺度关系与可隔离叠层，未见地图图钉或确认场地锚点。
cover.reason_en: The corrected text-free base preserves a continuous ordinary path, three distinct human-scale relationships, and an isolatable overlay without a map pin or confirmed-site anchor.

zhongzhiyuan.visible_ordinary_path_zh: 连续、无台阶的公众旁路与触觉导向意图；无需进入验证庭。
zhongzhiyuan.visible_ordinary_path_en: A continuous step-free public bypass with tactile-wayfinding intent; no entry into the proof court is required.
zhongzhiyuan.optional_proof_overlay_zh: 低矮可拆隔离边界内的临时庭院叠层。
zhongzhiyuan.optional_proof_overlay_en: A temporary court overlay contained behind a low removable isolation edge.
zhongzhiyuan.human_handoff_zh: 边界旁人工说明、拒绝、绕行与实体停止交接。
zhongzhiyuan.human_handoff_en: Staffed explanation, refusal, detour, and physical-stop handoff at the edge.
zhongzhiyuan.fault_and_bypass_zh: 设备与庭院下线，普通旁路继续。
zhongzhiyuan.fault_and_bypass_en: Equipment and court go offline while the ordinary bypass continues.
zhongzhiyuan.restoration_cue_zh: 撤除围挡、设备和线缆，恢复地面、绿化、声光后再讨论复测。
zhongzhiyuan.restoration_cue_en: Remove enclosure, equipment, and cables; restore surface, planting, sound, and light before considering retest.

origin_community.prototype_en: Screen-free daily street and two courts
origin_community.visible_ordinary_path_zh: 居民中轴连续通行、无屏停留和日常共学，不要求账户或 AI。
origin_community.visible_ordinary_path_en: Continuous resident passage, screen-free staying, and ordinary shared learning without an account or AI.
origin_community.optional_proof_overlay_zh: 位于路径之外的可撤回共创家具与临时活动。
origin_community.optional_proof_overlay_en: Withdrawable co-creation furniture and temporary activity outside the route.
origin_community.human_handoff_zh: 纸面说明、同意撤回与照护交接位于旁侧。
origin_community.human_handoff_en: Paper explanation, consent withdrawal, and safeguarding handoff sit to the side.
origin_community.fault_and_bypass_zh: 停止采集与匹配、撤除活动组件，居民街继续。
origin_community.fault_and_bypass_en: Stop capture and matching, remove event components, and keep the resident street open.
origin_community.restoration_cue_zh: 闭合同意撤回记录，把两院还给居民日常。
origin_community.restoration_cue_en: Close consent-withdrawal records and return both courts to resident daily use.

dazhongsi.prototype_zh: 通勤主轴与旁侧人工服务
dazhongsi.prototype_en: Commuter spine with off-route staffed service
dazhongsi.visible_ordinary_path_zh: 四向通勤意图、实体导向、静音休息和连续无障碍通行。
dazhongsi.visible_ordinary_path_en: Four-way commuting intent, physical wayfinding, quiet rest, and continuous accessible movement.
dazhongsi.optional_proof_overlay_zh: 路径之外的低平台与证据发布叠层。
dazhongsi.optional_proof_overlay_en: A low platform and evidence-release overlay outside the route.
dazhongsi.human_handoff_zh: 安静人工服务厅可独立完成同一基本任务与投诉交接。
dazhongsi.human_handoff_en: A quiet staffed hall can complete the same basic task and complaint handoff independently.
dazhongsi.fault_and_bypass_zh: 错误来源或服务下线，通勤和人工窗口继续。
dazhongsi.fault_and_bypass_en: A wrong source or service goes offline while commuting and staffed help continue.
dazhongsi.restoration_cue_zh: 撤除发布组件、纠正来源并完成未来全量复测。
dazhongsi.restoration_cue_en: Remove release components, correct sources, and complete a future full retest.

four_state_reading.rule_zh: 普通路径、无屏使用与人工服务先独立成立。
four_state_reading.rule_en: Ordinary paths, screen-free use, and staffed service work independently first.

four_state_reading.rule_zh: 图中只表达未来可选、限时、路径外叠层，不证明获准验证。
four_state_reading.rule_en: The image only expresses a future optional, time-bounded, off-route overlay; it does not prove authorized proof.

four_state_reading.rule_zh: 叠层停止并隔离，人工说明与普通绕行继续。
four_state_reading.rule_en: Stop and isolate the overlay while staffed explanation and the ordinary bypass continue.

four_state_reading.rule_zh: 先恢复普通场所；独立复核未闭合则保持停止或退役。
four_state_reading.rule_en: Restore the ordinary place first; remain stopped or retire if independent review does not close.
